# Belgium

Region: Europe. Sources verified 2026-10-11. Scope follows source documentation, not assumed nationwide CAMT availability.

## Country / regional references

### Febelfin

**Role:** Belgian financial-sector federation and national banking-standard publisher

**Reporting coverage:** Public Belgian subset guides for 053 and 054; the 053 guide also references the 052 v02 base schema. CODA is a separate fixed-width standard.

**Messages / versions:** camt.053.001.02; camt.054.001.02; camt.052.001.02 (reference); pain.002; pain.001; pain.008; CODA

- [Febelfin standards for online banking](https://febelfin.be/nl/publicaties/2023/febelfin-standaarden-voor-online-bankieren) — availability; public-page
- [CAMT 053 statement guideline 2.1](https://febelfin.be/media/pages/publicaties/2023/febelfin-standaarden-voor-online-bankieren/6779fe8903-1786373983/standard-camt053-statement-v2.1.pdf) — specification; public-file
- [CAMT 054 notification guideline 2.1](https://febelfin.be/media/pages/publicaties/2023/febelfin-standaarden-voor-online-bankieren/bbc7ad29ea-1786373475/standard-camt054-notification-v2.1.pdf) — specification; public-file
- [Archived bank standards](https://febelfin.be/nl/publicaties/2023/archief-bankstandaarden) — availability; public-page

Current landing links 242-page 053 and 223-page 054 guides. Guideline 2.1 uses namespace 001.02. No independent national 052 guide verified. 2025 payment-initiation publications do not establish CAMT v08 support. Febelfin disclaimer does not grant open redistribution.

See also the [Belgian CODA source investigation](../../../coda-published/README.md): original third-party fixtures and bank availability evidence, kept separate from bank-published XML.
